# Hello North Pole

> A personalised phone call from Father Christmas for children in the UK. Parents book online,
> share their child's details, and Father Christmas rings the parent's phone at the chosen time
> between 1 and 24 December. £9.99 per child, or £7.99 per child at the early-bird price until
> 30 November, with 25% off each extra brother or sister. Every booking is fully refundable until 1 December.

## How it works

- Parents book at https://hellonorthpole.co.uk/ and share details such as the child's name, age,
  friends, pets and what they've done well this year, so the call feels personal.
- Father Christmas calls any UK mobile or landline, at the exact time the parent chose, so the parent
  is always in control and hands the phone to the child.
- Calls run on weekday evenings between about 4pm and 8pm and throughout the day at weekends.
- Father Christmas can speak with children in several languages, not only English.
- Shy children are welcome: Father Christmas is patient and gentle and does most of the talking.
- Father Christmas's voice is created with carefully designed AI voice technology. Calls are not
  recorded unless the parent chooses.
